LanguageData.VV_Alert_ApocryphaChannelingDesc: Asphodel is drawing in the everflower's mana ({PROGRESS}, {TIMELEFT} remaining).\nIf the everflower is taken, the final bloom will be interrupted.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ApocryphaRebirth: The light left behind by the fallen queen has taken shape once more. Countless fairy vivis drawn from the everflower now wrap layer upon layer around Asphodel, the last empress.\n\nThe ancient needles have returned to hover behind her back.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaChannelInterrupted: Asphodel's usurpation of the everflower was interrupted.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaEscapedRoofCollapse: Asphodel teleported away from a roof collapse.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaShieldBroken: Asphodel's fairy barrier has scattered, briefly stunning her as fairy blooms sprout nearby.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaShieldRestored: The fairy vivis have gathered once more, restoring Asphodel's fairy barrier.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedleStuck: An ancient needle lodged in Asphodel's carapace, briefly stunning her.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedlesShakenOff: Asphodel has shaken off the lodged needles, drawing a swarm of titanic hornets toward the colony.
LanguageData.VV_Message_ApocryphaNeedleActivated: An ancient needle activates and aims at {PAWN_labelShort}.
LanguageData.VV_Speech_AsphodelRebirth1: ...No... not alone... I'll crumble, just like that day...
LanguageData.VV_Speech_AsphodelRebirth2: ...Before they're hurt... all of them... into my embrace...
LanguageData.VV_Speech_AsphodelDeath: ...The weight... into flowers... within this shade... my children, now...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AsphodelFallen: "{QUOTE}"\n\nAs the fairy vivis around her came unbound, Asphodel's form dissolved into golden petals and drifted toward the everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_FairyFlowerBound: The fairy bloom burst, turning nearby vivis into fairies and drawing them into Asphodel's embrace.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AsphodelReleased: Freed from Asphodel's embrace, the bound vivis have returned to their true forms before the everflower.\n\n{PAWNS}
